messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI perf alert on the calibration branch. Prefill TTFT regressed on long-context quantized builds (32k). Pasting minimal traces below.
perf-bot: Alert: perf/regression detected (prefill TTFT ↑ 35ms) on ref:calibration/optimize-scales — see job/bench-longctx-32k.
ali: Oof. Numbers?
maria: Quick paste:```
# bench summary (prefill vs decode)
prefill  kernel=fp8_gemm_v2  batch=16  seq=32768  TTFT=78ms  TPS=4200
decode   kernel=int8_deq_conv  batch=1  seq=2048   TTFT=11ms  TPS=6200
old-main prefill  TTFT=42ms  TPS=4100
```
cheng: Looks like calibration toggles picked a different prefill kernel path and disabled the fused-kv-eviction heuristic. That could cause prefill to hold KV locks longer and starve scheduler.
sam: That matches what I saw earlier when mixing fp8 kernels with legacy kvcache logic — microbatch flush misaligns and creates large prefill bubbles.
maria: I repro locally with smaller run: turning off scale-clipping in calib reduced prefill TTFT to ~46ms but decode TPS dropped ~5%. So tradeoff.
ali: Can you share the profile (nvprof/ncu) flame?
maria: pasted flame snippet (trimmed):```
GPU kernel timeline:
0-5ms    fp8_copy_qparams
5-45ms   fp8_gemm_v2(prefill)  [heavy]
45-55ms  kv_cache_lock
55-80ms  memcpy + sync
```
cheng: That kv_cache_lock peak is suspicious. Possibly a new per-shard mutex introduced in the calibration path. I suggested switching prefill to chunked_prefill (non-locking) path in #calib-ops.
sam: Also check batching heuristics — scheduler was combining large prefill groups (batch=16) while decode stayed single-token. Maybe we should enforce a prefill cap or prefer smaller prefill batches when FP8 is selected.
ali: Are there config knobs we can flip in runtime to mitigate while we patch? (e.g., kernel_pin, eviction_mode, prefill_batch_limit)
cheng: Yes: set KERNEL_POLICY=prefer_fp8_for_decode=false, PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=4, KV_EVICTION=aggressive. Quick experiments locally show PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=4 drops TTFT to ~50ms but TPS slightly lower.
maria: Good temporary mitigation. I'll open a regression ticket with a short perf reproduction and attach logs.
sam: Long-term, we should make kernel selection aware of KV semantics: prefer non-blocking kernels for prefill, even if slightly slower flops. Also add a perf test for calibration toggle.
ali: Can someone own the rollback if mitigation is insufficient?
cheng: I can take the fix — will try:1) re-enable fused-kv-eviction, 2) add chunked_prefill override for fp8 prefill, 3) add scheduler guardrail. Target PR today.
maria: TY. Created ticket INT-2345 and linked bench job. I'll run nightly check with PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=4 for the week. :eyes:
perf-bot: Linked job/bench-longctx-32k -> INT-2345 (regression).
ali: Great. Keep updates here and ping if you need hitless rollout plan. :thumbsup:
